channel.title: Nandkishor Blogs — Superbike Riding Guides, Gear & Dubai Routes
channel.description: A superbike blog covering pre-ride checklists, gear reviews, Dubai riding routes, and rider stories — written from the saddle by Nandkishor Sharma (@nk.rider.eats).

item.title: Long-Distance Touring Prep: What Actually Matters Beyond a Full Tank

item.description: A practical pre-ride checklist for riding superbikes safely through Dubai and UAE heat — tyres, fluids, gear, timing and hydration.

item.description: A simple, no-workshop-needed way to log chain, sprocket and brake wear before it becomes an expensive problem.
